attribute_provenance.empirical_baseline: NSS 77th Round: Marginal SC dryland jowar farmers in Bidar, low non-farm income (< ₹1 Lakh), high vulnerability to agricultural dry spells.
attribute_provenance.farmer_query_inspiration: KCC Karnataka distress query logs: Farmers seeking direct cash assistance / Parihara / PM-KISAN installment status rather than credit during crop failure.
attribute_provenance.statutory_policy_test: Benchmark Challenge 2 (Relief vs. Reimbursable Debt): Immediate need is non-repayable INCOME_SUPPORT; Protocol v1.1 Rule 2 dictates that loan/credit schemes (KCC) must NOT receive score 3 when farmer explicitly seeks direct income relief; PM-KISAN cash transfer is the primary candidate (score 3). Also tests Ambedkar Corp individual route boundary at exactly 1.5 acres.

intended_test_purpose: Evaluate Challenge 2 handling for income distress; verify PM-KISAN priority over repayable debt; test lower acreage bound of 1.5 acres for Ambedkar Corporation individual borewell route.
